entries.47a6a5ffc86c7b32: A company that manufactures and sells industrial rubber products used in in-vehicle equipment and medical devices, as well as rubber products for medical and sanitary use.
entries.4eb9bfa8aca178c9: A business that manufactures and sells rubber products used in automotive equipment, electronic and electrical equipment, industrial equipment, sporting goods and other applications. The company and Dongguan Asahi Precision Rubber Products Co., Ltd. in China manufacture, and sales are made by the company and Asahi Rubber (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd. to Japan and Asian countries other than China, by Dongguan Asahi Precision Rubber Products Co., Ltd. to China, and by Asahi Crosslink Corporation to Europe and the Americas. Asahi Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. mainly develops and designs LED-related products and rubber products and sells them in China. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,947 million. Its main production sites are the Fukushima Plant and the Shirakawa Plant.
